notes: The motor and charger entries rest on general Pedego statements, not on this model's details.

gaps: It gives no battery voltage or capacity, motor rating or controller for this model.
The model year is not pinned down.
method: The Canadian Pedego Assembly Instructions and Owners Manual (PDF file name ends 04132021) names the Comfort Cruiser in its gears, mechanical disc brake, rear light, battery and operating sections.

comps.spec: Integrated rear light that runs from the battery; turned on and off with the 'rear light' button on top of the battery. The manual's Comfort Cruiser lights section lists a rear light only.

Removable lithium-ion battery (manual says all Pedego models include a lithium ion battery). Slides forward into the battery holder and locks when fully inserted; a key lock releases it. Pack voltage and capacity are not stated for this model in this manual.

Battery charger included with the bike. Plugs into a standard household outlet. Charges a fully depleted battery in 4-5 hours; indicator is red or orange while charging and green when fully charged. Charger output is not stated for this model.
Brushless electric motor, per the manual's general introduction ('Our brushless electric motors'). No model-specific rating, wattage or position is stated in this manual.
7-speed drivetrain with a rear derailleur and thumb shifter; the rear wheel carries seven chain sprockets. The gears section lists Comfort Cruiser.
Mechanical (cable-actuated) disc brakes operated by two handlebar levers. A threaded barrel adjuster at the brake lever takes up cable slack. The mechanical disc brakes section lists Comfort Cruiser.
comps.loc: handlebar brake levers to front and rear brakes

comps.spec: Battery on/off switch on the bottom of the battery, marked '|' for on and 'O' for off. The manual says to switch it off when the bike is not in use or is charging.

sources.title: Pedego Assembly Instructions and Owners Manual, Canada (PDF, master manual covering several models)
